brief:
Israeli restrictions have cut off supplies of hearing aid batteries to Gaza, leaving residents dependent on the devices without access to replacements, Al Jazeera English reported. The blockade has prevented shipments of the batteries needed to power hearing aids, creating a critical shortage for deaf and hard-of-hearing Palestinians.

The supply crisis affects a population already struggling under broader shortages of medical equipment and supplies. Hearing aid users face the prospect of their devices becoming inoperable without access to replacement batteries, compounding communication difficulties in the territory.
dek: Israeli restrictions have left Gaza facing a severe shortage of hearing aid batteries.
title: Israeli restrictions create hearing aid battery shortage in Gaza
